trace.claim: The paper attributes to prior research the claim that 'conservative political orientation and a conservative political climate are both associated with COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy and decreased likelihood of receiving a COVID-19 vaccine' and then disputes or builds on this by showing that the effect is moderated by regional climate, particularly that conservatives in liberal climates are less hesitant and more likely to receive boosters.[page 10]
